plugins.name: grimoire
plugins.description: A spellbook of agent skills for AI. Cast wisely. Two skills: eagle-eye, which lays coupled decisions out as a morphological box and renders a page that reads any configuration back; and groundtrack, which draws a plan or a written change as a call graph a reader can step through.
